body:
IMMEDIATE CONTRADICTIONS:
1) “PWA multi-display” overstates the dependable contract. The reliable cross-browser behavior is ordinary window.open + manual drag + local fullscreen gesture; Window Management is Chromium-desktop limited/experimental, popup-blockable, permission-dependent, and mirroring is not a distinct screen. PWA installation grants none of these powers. Sell guided setup, not automatic dual display.
2) “5-second verified live web evidence” conflates retrieval speed with epistemic certainty. Search snippets/LLM verdicts are not evidence; origin fetch, date/entity/unit reconciliation, rights/privacy/ACL, and human approval create long tails. The only defensible <=5s target is private candidate arrival, with abstention dominant on hard claims.
3) A second evidence screen may reduce comprehension through split attention and visual-channel overload. It is not inherently an improvement; frequent unsolicited cards can compete with speaker and slides, become stale before read, and publicly amplify disputed claims.
4) The product currently optimizes the most failure-prone path for the demo. A simpler reliable core is presenter-only evidence/coaching plus a pre-approved public evidence library; live web remains private beta until measured.
